task: Morsel #263 independent exhaustive numeric-voice source audit
scope: All .swift files recursively under app/Sources/Morsel; source inspection only, no issue-inventory adoption
output_policy: Only the requested independent-audit.json artifact is authored; no repository writes, rendering, builds, git mutation or GitHub writes.

group_normalization.decision: Treat the supplied five affected bullets as six by separating Weight / chart labels from Rows / columns. Kept-mono technical is a seventh, separate unchanged category, not one of the six affected groups.
group_normalization.group_overlap_rule: One source helper may serve multiple groups (SectionHeading, JournalPaperField.valueFont). Shared-site memberships overlap intentionally; never sum them as unique sites. Field-construction entries are indirection usages of PaperFields.swift:91, not extra font-token expressions.

method.scan: Recursive Swift scan of all files, broad identifier sweep and separate system-monospaced/font-feature sweep; read every matching file plus caller/formatter/model sources. Classify actual Text/TextField/Button/Image consumers and propagate shared helpers to callers.
method.font_weight_note: Sizes are declared base points, before Dynamic Type. Regular/Medium are resolved through DesignSystem named bundled fonts, nominal 400/500; actual runtime font resolution is not verified.
method.match_accounting: Every broad matched source line is assigned exactly one disposition in discovery_matches; each font consumption has a structured font_sites entry; every JournalPaperField construction is listed, including false/default cases.
method.runtime_limits: No assumption about data cardinality: per-day/per-item/menu counts are dynamic. Reuse counts describe static source wiring, not an observed frame.

affected_groups.label: Rows / columns, including dates, time, provenance and metadata

kept_mono_technical.rule: Only actual configured MCP URLs, setup-prompt blocks and endpoint Copy/Copied pills. Nonnumeric app prose is not classified as technical simply because it sits near setup.

font_definitions.source: static func morselMono(size: CGFloat) -> Font { Font.custom("IBM Plex Mono", size: size) }
static func morselMonoMedium(size: CGFloat) -> Font { Font.custom("IBM Plex Mono Medium", size: size) }
